title: chart
description: Numbers over a row of names as a line or as upright bars, on one scale from 0, with their numbers in a folded table: a line for how a number moves, bars for comparing them. Sideways bars of one list are the part bars

kind.description: line draws each series as a line, bar as upright bars from 0

unit.description: The unit of the values, drawn small after the title

x.description: The names along the bottom, each in '…'

min.description: kind line only: where the scale starts instead of 0. With a value below it, it is not used, and the scale takes in 0 and every value

series.description: At most 4, as colours tell them apart: draw more as another chart

values.description: A number for each of x, in its order

then.$comment: LIMIT: the keys every chart takes but min, copied: add a key to properties here too, or a bar chart refuses it as an additional property. A mistake is told at the chart, not at its min, and a misspelt key beside min is told twice, here and by the chart's own additionalProperties
